title: blob.rs download_blob: Vec allocation for vars — use inline array slice
description: blob.rs lines 202-210: download_blob builds vars as let vars = vec![...] then immediately passes it as &[(&str, &str)] to expand_url_template. Since the count is known at compile time, an inline array borrow avoids the heap allocation: expand_url_template(template, &[("accountId", account_id), ...]). upload_blob already uses this pattern correctly on line 124.
